rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Maison. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Maison is a full-service restaurant and bar that serves food until 10pm every night, with menu options for everyone. To reserve a table, you need to pre-purchase a dinner package.
concessions.quote: We serve food until 10pm every night.

gates.summary: The Maison is open every day of the week. The restaurant opens at 4pm on weekdays and 1pm on Saturdays, and the main stage is downstairs with a mezzanine overlooking it and The Penthouse stage on the third floor.
gates.quote: Our full service restaurant opens weekdays at 4pm, and 1pm on Saturdays.
